content.stem: 以下哪些是最新KYC解决方案(包括但不限于数字开户、电子KYC、数字身份、面部识别、活体检测、生物识别和地理定位)的优势？(选择三项.)

options.A: 确保在所有司法管辖区的监管合规方面达到100%的准确率
options.B: 通过提供个性化推荐来提高客户满意度
options.D: 提供可靠的客户身份验证以增强信任
options.E: 减少客户身份验证所需的时间

content.stem_en: Which of the following are benefits of the latest KYC solutions, including but not limited to digital onboarding, eKYC, digital identity, facial recognition, liveness checks, biometrics, and geolocation? (Choose Three.)

options_en.A: Guaranteeing 100% accuracy in regulatory compliance across all jurisdictions.
options_en.B: Improving customer satisfaction by offering personalized recommendations.
options_en.D: Providing reliable customer authentication to enhance trust.
options_en.E: Decreasing the time required for customer authentication.
